badge: Topic 3 · Robot Kinematics  |  Franka Panda · 7 joints

captions.title: Inverse Kinematics
captions.body: Goal: keep the gripper on the red cube

captions.title: We only say WHERE the hand should go
captions.body: The robot works out all 7 joint angles by itself

captions.title: Inverse kinematics (IK)
captions.body: Hand position → joint angles, recomputed 60 times a second

captions.title: Many ways to reach one point
captions.body: Several arm poses reach the same spot. The solver picks a smooth, safe one.

captions.title: Leaving the workspace
captions.body: The target moves beyond the arm's reach (about 0.85 m)

captions.title: Out of reach
captions.body: The arm stretches fully and stops: no joint angles can reach the target
